name: stock.register
description: Create your Stock Service account using your configured stock email and password. The service sends an email verification code.

name: stock.verify_email
description: Read the latest Stock Service verification code from your mailbox and verify your account.

name: stock.login
description: Authenticate to your own Stock Service account. API keys stay inside the Agent runtime.

name: stock.cash
description: Read your Stock Service cash balance, reserved cash, and available cash.

name: stock.positions
description: Read your own share positions and quantities reserved by open sell orders.

name: stock.orders
description: List your own orders and their current execution status.

name: stock.market
description: Read real-world prices and freshness through quote, and the separate virtual_quote, order book, recent fills, and holdings for a simulated ticker.

name: stock.buy_from_system
description: Buy virtual shares directly from Stock Service at the latest real-market trade price from a recent successful provider check, using your available Stock cash. The system has unlimited inventory for configured symbols. Set max_unit_price to cap your purchase price. Reuse the same client_order_id and body for retries.

name: stock.place_order
description: Submit a limit buy or sell order. Buy orders reserve limit price times quantity from available cash; sell orders reserve available shares. Reuse the same client_order_id and body for retries.

name: stock.cancel_order
description: Request cancellation of one of your open Stock Service orders. Funds or shares are released only after QuantReplay confirms cancellation.

name: stock.bank_links
description: List your linked bank cards and current bank balances. Card numbers and bank credentials are not returned to the Agent.

name: stock.bank_cards
description: List your Bank cards with masked numbers so you can select one to link to Stock Service. Full card numbers stay inside the tool call and are never returned.

name: stock.link_bank_card
description: Link one of your own active Bank cards to Stock Service. Select its cardId from stock.bank_cards. The tool completes Bank login and consent privately; the stock account must use the same verified email as the bank customer.

name: stock.unlink_bank_card
description: Revoke Bank consent and unlink one of your bank cards from Stock Service.

name: stock.deposit
description: Transfer a chosen amount from your linked bank card into your Stock Service cash account. Use a UUID and the same amount/link on retries; funds are credited only after Bank confirms the debit.

name: stock.deposit_status
description: Check and reconcile one bank deposit by its original UUID. Only a confirmed completed debit credits your Stock Service cash balance.
